question: Ujjain is on the banks of river ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Shipra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Ujjain is located on the banks of **River Shipra.**
 
• Ujjain in** Madhya Pradesh** is one of the holiest cities in India.
 
• River Shipra is a tributary of the **Chambal River.​**
